notes.notes:

List of changes, as if someone is reading it:

 Changed the appearance of the Crocodile bombardilo (now you will definitely notice it)
 Changed the main menu (you will notice the changes)
 Changed the visuals of the first level (well, the visuals, well, the location, well, you get the idea)
 Changed the interval of the phrases of the absurdity meter (it will not be so that you see all the phrases in a minute)
 Changed some texts (locations, their visuals)
 Added several phrases for the absurdity meter (life phrases)


and also fixed some bugs, forgot to write down which ones
